In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]] '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tervissis]]. The invasion was preceded by Imperial [[Raids on Tervissis|raids]] against the planet [[18 BBY/Legends|five years earlier]] as part of the [[Listehol Campaign]], in which the Imperials strove to drive out [[Tervig]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], along with [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild|Zygerrian slavers]] and [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], from the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The invasion was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" />
